description: This file exports type definitions and functions related to sandbox management, SSH sessions, and plugin command execution within a software project. It mainly re-exports entities from other modules, acting as an aggregator or index.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a command to execute remotely with specified parameters.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a remote command string.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Builds argument vector for SSH sandbox.

methods.name: createRemoteShellSandboxFsBridge
methods.description: Creates a filesystem bridge for remote shell sandbox.

methods.name: createWritableRenameTargetResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for writable rename targets.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from configuration text.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from given settings.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Disposes of an existing SSH sandbox session.

methods.name: getSandboxBackendFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the sandbox backend factory.

methods.name: getSandboxBackendManager
methods.description: Retrieves the sandbox backend manager.

methods.name: registerSandboxBackend

methods.name: requireSandboxBackendFactory
methods.description: Requires a sandbox backend factory.

methods.name: resolveWritableRenameTargets
methods.description: Resolves writable rename targets.

methods.description: Runs a command in SSH sandbox.

methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables.

methods.description: Escapes shell special characters.
